import csv, collections
for fn in ['JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv','ZF_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv']:
    print('====',fn)
    with open(fn,newline='') as f:
        r=csv.DictReader(f)
        rows=list(r)
    print('cols', list(rows[0].keys()))
    print('rows',len(rows))
    print('chroms', collections.Counter(x['Chromosome'] for x in rows))
    print('unique Pos', len(set(x['Pos'] for x in rows)))
    print('unique (Pos,Chromosome)', len(set((x['Pos'],x['Chromosome']) for x in rows)))
    print('unique StartPosition per chrom?', collections.Counter((x['Chromosome'], x['StartPosition']) for x in rows).most_common(3))
    # methylation range
    vals=[float(x['MethylationPercentage']) for x in rows]
    print('meth min/max',min(vals),max(vals), 'rows >90',sum(v>90 for v in vals),'rows <10',sum(v<10 for v in vals),'both',sum(v>90 or v<10 for v in vals))
    # unique filtered positions
    filt_pos=set((x['Chromosome'], x['Pos']) for x in rows if (lambda v:v>90 or v<10)(float(x['MethylationPercentage'])))
    print('unique filtered positions',len(filt_pos))
    print('filtered rows',sum(1 for x in rows if float(x['MethylationPercentage'])>90 or float(x['MethylationPercentage'])<10))
PY
